verses.t: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant
verses.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant

verses.t: Did He not make their plan into misguidance
verses.pickthall: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught

verses.t: And He sent against them birds in flocks
verses.pickthall: And send against them swarms of flying creatures

verses.t: Striking them with stones of hard clay
verses.pickthall: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay

verses.t: And He made them like eaten straw
verses.pickthall: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)
